rationale: The condition determines whether fail/pass outcomes reliably distinguish latency exceedance from run-to-run noise, allowing the reduction pattern to justify an inference about failure-inducing changes. Repeated controls and adjusted repeats and inconclusive bands establish that evidential reliability; their procedural form does not make this merely an execution requirement.
uncertainty: No observations establish whether the latency gap is sufficiently distinguishable from run-to-run variation.
